The full cycle follows a coupled rigid-contact calculation: input rotation is shared between reaction-gear rotation and worm/carriage travel. A resisting carriage load is assumed; the lever follows its current contact branch and the band returns it toward neutral when released. Red highlights indicate carriage motion under lever–lozenge restraint. Calculated release occurs at approximately −3.76 / +3.75 mm, before the mechanical travel limits. This is a geometric motion model, not a prediction of force, friction, flexibility or reliable printed operation. Travel and lever sliders remain manual inspection controls.
